bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
idfile="$root/deploy/secrets/bug_report_userbot_account.txt"
test -f "$idfile" && test ! -L "$idfile" || exit 63
owner="$(cat "$idfile")"
[[ "$owner" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{3,18}$ ]] || exit 64
n="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM link_button_posts WHERE owner_user_id=$owner AND content='リンク機能テスト用の本文' AND share_code IS NOT NULL AND status='draft';" 2>/dev/null)" || exit 65
test "$n" -ge 1 || exit 66
logs="$(docker logs --since 75m --tail 1500 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 || true)"
if printf '%s' "$logs" | grep -Fq '[LINK_INLINE_QUERY_FAILED]'; then
 if printf '%s' "$logs" | grep -Eiq '(RICH_MESSAGE|RICH_BLOCK|Bad Request|BUTTON_DATA_INVALID)'; then exit 71; fi
 if printf '%s' "$logs" | grep -Eiq '(LINK_SHARE_READBACK|LINK_OWNER|LINK_MEDIA|LINK_STYLE|LINK_URL)'; then exit 72; fi
 exit 73
fi
echo LINK_INLINE_TEST_OWNER_MATCH=PASS
echo LINK_INLINE_BOT_ERROR_LOG=NONE
